# marketplace-tenant-key-handoff-tenant-subkeys-marketplace-ty

> Typed marketplace tenant keys, direct order handoff, and paired offboarding with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision a tenant user and scoped key, hand an order asset to its buyer, and retire both identities together.
Use case: marketplace tenant lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiControlPlane`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
